decision.rationale: The five lightweight plans and their proportional validation pass, but the PR also adds the superseded eight-plan requirements as a still-Confirmed current contract. That direct documentation conflict must be removed or explicitly marked superseded before merge.

summary: The intended six lightweight planning documents are coherent, linked and trace-complete, and the original v0.1 baseline is unchanged. Approval is withheld only because the full PR diff still adds a conflicting old eight-plan requirements document without a superseded marker.

findings.title: Superseded eight-plan requirements remain marked Confirmed
findings.observation: The full PR diff adds the old project-management requirements as Status Confirmed. Its goals and functional requirements still mandate eight IP documents, the old status model and the old lifecycle contract, while the new confirmed lightweight requirements and management entry mandate five LP documents and a simpler status model. The old file has no superseded or abandoned marker and no replacement link.
findings.trigger: A maintainer, AI client or later Requirements task searches the repository for current project-management requirements after merge.
findings.impact: The repository presents two incompatible current planning contracts, so an executor can restore the abandoned eight-plan governance direction and the lightweight cleanup outcome is not unambiguous.

evidence.description: The base-to-head diff adds docs/feature/v0-1-project-management/requirements.md; lines 3, 42-49 and 146-163 keep the eight-plan contract current.
The replacement requirements require cleanup of old complex governance documents and define LP-01 through LP-05 as the current plan boundaries.
The current management entry exposes only LP-01 through LP-05 with the new controlled statuses.

findings.remediation: Ensure the old file no longer appears as a current confirmed contract: remove it from this PR, or clearly mark it Superseded/Abandoned at the top, link to the lightweight replacement requirements and eliminate current-status ambiguity. Preserve docs/feature/v0-1-project-plan as the original product baseline.
findings.verification: At a new exact head, confirm the repository exposes one current five-plan contract, then rerun the full diff, target-file, link, section, status, trace and original-baseline checks.

required_actions.action: Remove the old eight-plan requirements from the PR or mark them unmistakably superseded and link the current lightweight requirements.

risks.description: Two incompatible requirements documents are presented as current and can send future work back toward the abandoned governance direction.
No high-signal credential pattern was found in the documentation diff.
risks.mitigation: Future LP implementations must perform their own security review.

risks.description: The original product, domain, protocol, architecture and source implementation-plan baseline is unchanged.
